overview.title: How CFN turns work into checked results
overview.summary: CFN combines agent workflows, verification gates and supporting infrastructure. Start with one source-backed walkthrough, then use the directory and dependency views to inspect implementation details.
overview.coverage: One capability has been traced in depth. The remaining directory entries are an inventory and have not been reviewed as independent capabilities.
